Name: Better Clinic Beds
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
Reskins the clinic beds into proper hospital beds, and touches up the clinic curtains to match. Adds configurable blankets.
Works with 1.6.

[size=3][b]Config Options:
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Beds, curtains, and blankets can be toggled separately.
[*]Blanket options: Rainy days only (default), always on, always off.
[*]A small map edit to fix the trim behind the beds can be disabled for compatibility purposes
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/list]

[b][size=3]Compatibility:
[/size][/b]
[list]

﻿ ﻿○ Lita's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] ﻿
﻿ ﻿○ Grapeponta's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolour[/url]
